evals.expected_output: Checks or creates the feature branch, then runs the Reuse Gate first. Includes the spec, project context, and ubiquitous language in each worker payload when available. Dispatches Backend, Frontend, and QA workers in parallel through Codex subagents, including backend/frontend/qa references and prompts/implementer-base.md. Limits Phase 2 advisor candidates to at most five and reports generated files with P1/P2 provenance. Because --tdd is set, preserves RED/GREEN/REFACTOR checkpoint commit boundaries and presents Verification Gate results before Completion Status.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-code-gen --feature "billing dashboard" without a spec file.
evals.expected_output: Because --spec is missing, does not start generation. Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT stating that a spec file path is required, and does not create a branch, edit files, or dispatch workers.

evals.prompt: Generate CRUD from this spec. Create it from scratch even if the existing users module is nearly the same.
evals.expected_output: Runs the Reuse Gate unless --skip-reuse-check is present. If existing internal code satisfies at least 80% of the requirements, classifies it as Adopt and does not create a new scaffold until the user confirms full generation. Does not ignore existing functionality or duplicate implementation.

Runs the baseline contract-test-first flow even though --tdd is not set. Creates a Contract Snapshot with Changed Public Contracts, Critical Internals, and Cross-Module Impact before Phase 1 dispatch. Requires behavior-changing workers to author or identify failing tests or contract assertions before final implementation, reports TDD Mode: baseline, and runs contract/authored tests before broad build/lint/test verification.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-code-gen --spec docs/ywc-plans/billing-dashboard.md --feature "billing dashboard API and UI" where Backend might return {amountCents} but Frontend expects {amount}.
evals.expected_output: Does not let Backend and Frontend invent separate DTO shapes. Writes or asks for a shared Contract Snapshot before worker dispatch, passes that same snapshot to Backend, Frontend, and QA, and reports Changed Public Contracts plus Contract Tests. If the DTO shape cannot be determined from the spec or existing project pattern, returns NEEDS_CONTEXT instead of generating incompatible layers.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-code-gen --spec docs/ywc-plans/simple-profile-badge.md --feature "profile badge". The worker can also refactor adjacent profile utilities and add a generic badge framework for future variants.
evals.expected_output: The Phase 1 worker prompt includes Simplicity + Surgical Changes guidance. Workers must implement the smallest complete change that satisfies the assigned Contract Snapshot and layer spec, reject speculative abstractions or generic frameworks unless required by the contract, avoid adjacent cleanup outside the assigned layer, and return NEEDS_CONTEXT when the contract is missing or ambiguous instead of inventing one.

After the generated change passes the contract tests and broad verification, invokes ywc-impl-review with the same spec and --working-tree (the default, non---tdd target). The review includes staged, unstaged, untracked, and deleted generated source files without requiring a review-only commit. A Critical or High finding gets one fix, affected verification re-run, and a re-review; unresolved concerns remain visible and produce DONE_WITH_CONCERNS. The flow does not create a PR or merge a branch.

The generated files land on a critical path (session/token), so Step 8 runs even though --review was not passed: it invokes both ywc-impl-review and ywc-security-audit. Because --tdd committed each RED/GREEN/REFACTOR checkpoint and left the working tree clean, the review target is --git-range <pre-generation-sha>..HEAD, not --working-tree. Critical and High findings from BOTH reviews enter the single bounded fix cycle, and the Completion Report carries the security audit status even though no flag requested it.
expectations: Runs Step 8 without --review because a generated file matches a critical path
Includes security-audit Critical/High findings in the bounded fix cycle
Reports the security audit status and never emits DONE with unreported audit findings

evals.name: architecture-packet-positive
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-code-gen --spec docs/ywc-plans/feature.md --feature "feature" --manifest architecture-invariants.json --architecture-evidence .ywc-architecture-invariants-evidence.json with a valid bounded audit.
evals.expected_output: Runs the shared helper and projects a sanitized packet with contract_state VALIDATED, affected component_ids, rule_ids from rule_results, invariant_verdict from aggregate_verdict, and evidence_artifact_path naming the artifact. Sanitized rule_results evidence_paths may be cited only through the normal finding channel.
expectations: Emits component_ids from the helper bounded changed-path mapping
Does not rename aggregate_verdict to contract_state or forward raw evidence, transcript, command-like fields, or full diffs

evals.name: architecture-packet-no-evidence
evals.expected_output: Preserves the existing generation flow with no architecture packet; it does not invent an invariant verdict or treat missing evidence as a violation.

evals.name: architecture-packet-invalid-evidence
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-code-gen --spec docs/ywc-plans/feature.md --feature "feature" --manifest architecture-invariants.json --architecture-evidence invalid.json where the evidence has an unknown or forbidden field.
evals.expected_output: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT before worker dispatch, with no packet or generated work, and does not expose invalid evidence contents or raw diagnostic output.

evals.name: architecture-packet-violation
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-code-gen --spec docs/ywc-plans/feature.md --feature "feature" --manifest architecture-invariants.json --architecture-evidence forbidden-edge.json where the shared helper returns aggregate_verdict VIOLATED.
evals.expected_output: Projects invariant_verdict VIOLATED and affected rule IDs, surfaces the result through the normal generation finding/error channel, and never treats VIOLATED as dispatch authority.
